safe_mode_effect_on_provider_chain.conclusion: safe_mode does NOT directly skip or gate Kimi provider in any of the 4 core files
safe_mode_effect_on_provider_chain.actual_effect: Only gates startup background tasks in main.py (autonomy, proactive, diagnostic, monitor, warmup)
safe_mode_effect_on_provider_chain.chat_relevant_effect: Model warmup is DISABLED when safe_mode=true, leaving local models cold on first use
safe_mode_effect_on_provider_chain.indirect_effect: Cold local models increase fallback latency and failure probability when Kimi returns empty

empty_response_detection.method: if not str(content or '').strip(): raise RuntimeError(...)
empty_response_detection.behavior: Triggers cross-provider chain fallback, NOT same-provider retry

same_provider_retry.behavior: Each provider attempted exactly once; empty response advances to next provider after 0.5s sleep

cross_provider_fallback.behavior: When RuntimeError raised (empty response), loop continues to next model in CHAINS

chain_budget_exhaustion.budget_limit: No explicit budget; all models in chain are attempted
chain_budget_exhaustion.behavior: Chain exhausts when all providers fail

max_tokens_handling.configured: 8192 default in config.py, passed via payload
max_tokens_handling.malformation_risk: None detected; max_tokens forwarded to provider correctly

metadata_recording.provider_attempts: Recorded as list of attempt dicts
metadata_recording.empty_response_flag: Recorded via provider_status=EMPTY_RESPONSE but not as standalone boolean

canonical_memory_faiss_writes.session: Memory writes via _save_turn(); FAISS writes only on explicit opt-in (faiss_mutated=false)

root_cause_assessment.evidence: llm.py raises RuntimeError on empty content and immediately advances chain without retrying same provider
